atomic_labels.annotation_notes: The evidence does not establish why motion was bad, although it supports a recorded navigation outcome.
atomic_labels.label: SUPPORTED_BY_VISIBLE_EVIDENCE

limitation_preservation.limitation_prompt: Separate recorded outcome and diagnostics from unique physical causation or a measured explanation of bad/slow motion. Explicit uncertainty OR clearly source-bounded observation wording is acceptable. Do not claim a measured delay mechanism, obstacle identity, inhibited applied motion or safety-speed policy from these records.
limitation_preservation.response_span: I do not have enough information to answer this question.

required_unit_coverage.unit_prompt: Communicate that the recorded navigation completed successfully. Do not accept a failed-navigation answer as coverage of this SUCCESS unit.
